ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized speckling, water droplets, and parasitic clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity field across both lobes. A distinct medium-intensity amorphous patch (grey/white) is located on the upper-right lobe near the trailing edge. High-intensity nodes are concentrated at the extreme lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular; the left lobe shows frequent low-amplitude serrations. The right lobe features a prominent, high-amplitude jagged recession approximately mid-way between the notch and the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve sweeping upward and outward from the peduncle, terminating in sharp, slightly posterior-pointing tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular high-density clusters (barnacles) are spatially localized on the extreme outer tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Scattered, short horizontal high-intensity linear markings are visible across the lower-medial sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation (possible tissue loss) on the trailing edge of the right lobe; dense barnacle colonization on lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a singular, non-symmetrical light-grey pigmentation patch on the distal region of the right lobe.
